name: Puerto Rico

endonyms.name: Estado Libre Asociado de Puerto Rico

flag.description: Five equal horizontal stripes alternating red and white, with a blue equilateral triangle at the hoist bearing a large white five-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: It was created in 1895 by Puerto Rican independence activists in New York, deliberately reversing the colors of Cuba's flag to show the two islands' shared struggle against Spanish rule.

hook: Puerto Rico is Cuba with the colors swapped: red stripes and a blue triangle, where Cuba has blue stripes and a red triangle.
trivia: Displaying the flag was effectively outlawed by Puerto Rico's 1948 "Gag Law", which was repealed in 1957.
No shade of blue is fixed by law: the flag has been flown in light, medium and dark blue, and the shade chosen is often read as a political statement.
